closure_scope: Bounded historical positive-outcome validation of Rio Mala overflow behavior from 2017 through 2025, with independent official station-monitoring and spatial context. This does not approve or activate the Phase-2 zone contract and does not close tributary debris-flow mechanisms.

compound_event_context.note: The official report describes a huaico increasing Rio Mala flow before overflow. It supports compound-system plausibility but is not generalized into a universal tributary activation rule.

hydrologic_monitoring_context.note: These official station observations demonstrate hydrologic monitoring context. They are not paired event-day discharges for the historical positive outcomes and are not transferred to impact reaches.

spatial_context.river_margin_extent: Puente San Antonio to sector Azpitia
spatial_context.note: Official river-margin and critical-sector evidence constrain the corridor and exposure context but are neither an observed inundation footprint nor a complete normalized basin polygon.

negative_control_status.note: No absence-of-damage or no-report record is promoted into a hydrologic negative. This bounded research closeout is based on multiple independently documented positive outcomes.

forbidden_promotions: La Capilla station values into unmeasured impact-reach discharge
SENAMHI provider alert bands into IRFEN thresholds
2016 ANA river-margin geometry into observed flood footprint
2026 hydrologic observations into historical event-day truth
2023 compound huaico-river sequence into a universal tributary rule

closure.reason: Multiple official sources independently document recurrent Rio Mala overflow impacts across 2017, 2021, 2024 and 2025; official SENAMHI station observations demonstrate a traceable hydrologic monitoring lane; and ANA material supplies bounded river-margin and critical-sector context. The absence of event-paired station flow, a confirmed negative control and complete basin/hydraulic geometry is retained explicitly rather than fabricated.
does_not_authorize: approval of the lima_sur_mala Phase-2 zone contract
closing tributary ravines as validated components
claiming current channel capacity from historical outcomes
